name: autoloot
author: BlaXun
description: An Autoloot window in game: loot every drop at or below a rarity you choose, whole item types such as cards, and a list of exact items -- with a monster check that shows what you would pick up. Works even where @autoloot is kept for GMs, and your item list is kept across logins.

settings.label: Let the exact-item list hold 30 items
settings.description: Instead of rAthena's 10. Takes effect when the server restarts.
